name: Ivana Kovačić
bio:
Ivana's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for fluid dynamics, sparked by the powerful gusts of the Adriatic wind during her childhood in Split. She excelled in engineering, specializing in aerodynamics and securing a pivotal role at a prominent Croatian aerospace firm before transitioning to Formula racing. Her analytical prowess and innovative solutions quickly propelled her through the ranks. 

At Toyota Gazoo Racing, Ivana leads her team with a forward-thinking approach, always pushing the boundaries of aerodynamic design. She values precision and collaboration, striving to create a work environment where meticulous analysis meets creative problem-solving. Her distinctive approach lies in her ability to visualize complex airflow patterns, transforming theoretical concepts into tangible performance improvements on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with subtle waves and a professional look.
physical.description: Ivana has a strong, determined face with a warm smile that belies her intense focus.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches.
Insists on using traditional drafting tools alongside digital simulations.
Starts every team meeting with a brief physics problem to stimulate thinking.
